$comment: Haijun Changesets Config - Adapted from @changesets/config for Haijun Ecosystem
title: HaijunChangesetsConfig
description:
Configuration schema for .changeset/config.json in Haijun projects. Changesets help manage versioning and changelogs.

Documentation: https://github.com/changesets/changesets
Haijun Ecosystem: https://tracks.web.id

changelog.description: The base configuration for the changelog generation. This will be resolved to a module providing a default export of a function taking in a changeset and options, and returning the updated changelog.

commit.description: Whether or not to commit the changes made by changesets when running `changeset version` or `changeset publish`.

fixed.description: The packages to be fixed together in versioning. Packages in the same fixed group will always have the same version number.

linked.description: The packages to be linked together in versioning. Packages in the same linked group will have the same version number, but the version will only be bumped if there is a changeset for the package.

access.description: Whether or not packages should be public or private when publishing.

baseBranch.description: The branch on which to find changesets to determine versioning.

updateInternalDependencies.description: The strategy to use when updating internal dependencies.

ignore.description: A list of packages that should be ignored when determining version bumps.

___experimentalUnsafeOptions_ONLY_USE_WI.description: Options that are potentially unsafe and may change or be removed in any release.
